item.title: Americans rank clergy at record low in honesty and ethics ratings: Gallup
item.description: The public perception of the honesty and ethical standards of clergy reached a record low over the last 50 years, according to Gallup’s annual honesty and ethics survey. Just 27% of the American public ranked clergy as high or very high on the scale. #Gallup #Trust #Honesty #Clergy #recordlow

item.title: Actor James Van Der Beek shared evangelistic message, revelation about God before his death
item.description: Actor James Van Der Beek, who portrayed Dawson Leery on the television drama “Dawson’s Creek” and died Feb. 11 at age 48 after living with Stage 3 colorectal cancer, shared an evangelistic reflection about God during the final phase of his life. #ChristianActors #JamesVanDerBeek #DawsonLeery #DawsonsCreek #ColorectalCancer #EvangelisticMessage #God #Spirituality #Christianity

item.title: Pastor, wife who used addiction recovery center as front, convicted of multimillion dollar retail theft
item.description: A Florida pastor and his wife, who used an addiction recovery center as a front to run a multimillion dollar retail theft scheme, have been convicted and are now facing possible sentences of up to 150 and 30 years in prison, respectively. #Retailtheftscheme #RobertBell #JaclynDell #HomeDepot

item.title: Churches could run gov't supported ‘marriage bootcamps’ to 'save' America: report
item.description: Local churches could run government-supported marriage bootcamps for cohabiting couples with children in a bid to get them to formally walk down the aisle with the promise of a “wedding bonus” of up to $5,000, researchers suggest in a new report. #HeritageFoundation #Marriage #Cohabiting

item.title: Savannah Guthrie pleads with kidnapper 2 weeks after mom's disappearance: 'We believe'
item.description: “Today” show co-host Savannah Guthrie continues to plead for her missing mother’s safe return two weeks after her disappearance, assuring the individual responsible for her disappearance that “it is never too late to do the right thing” and maintaining her belief in “the essential goodness of every human being.” #SavannahGuthrie #FBI #Kidnapping #Arizona #NancyGuthrie

item.title: Marco Rubio says Christian faith helped forge Western civilization, warns against open borders
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio received sustained applause Saturday after his speech at a major European security conference in which he praised Christianity as a central part of Western identity and urged tighter border controls. #MarcoRubio #MunichSecurityConference #EuropeanSecurity #Christianity #Immigration #Russia #Ukraine #China

item.title: Churches in India take challenge to anti-conversion laws to Supreme Court
item.description: India’s Supreme Court has set the stage for a landmark constitutional review of anti-conversion laws across 12 states, as Christian bodies mount parallel legal challenges to legislation they say has been systematically weaponized against religious minorities. #India #anticonversionlaws #persecution

item.title: Iran killed at least 19 Christians involved in anti-regime protests: watchdog
item.description: Iran’s security forces killed at least 19 Christians during a sweeping crackdown on anti-government protests, according to a monitoring group, which said the confirmed toll rose after two more Christian converts died from gunfire during demonstrations last month. #Iran #Tehran #KillingofChristians #CrackdownonAntiGovernmentProtests #ChristianConverts #ChristianPersecution #IslamicRepublic

item.title: Texas schools announce plans to drop student photo vendor over links to Epstein files
item.description: At least half a dozen Texas schools have pledged to either change or cancel plans to use a popular student photo vendor due to parental concerns after a former executive was mentioned in the Jeffrey Epstein files. #Texas #SchoolPictures #EpsteinFiles

item.title: Bethel Church places Pastor Ben Armstrong on leave after former student alleges clergy sexual abuse
item.description: Leaders at Bethel Church announced Sunday that Ben Armstrong, the Prophetic Ministry director at the church and former BSSM Revival Group pastor, has been placed on administrative leave following the release of a YouTube video in which a former student publicly alleges clergy sexual abuse dating back to 2009. #BenArmstrong #BethelChurch #sexualassault
